# .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/

GitHub Issue templates for this repository.

## Templates

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| [`bug_report.md`](bug_report.md) | Structured template for reporting bugs — prompts for expected vs. actual behaviour, reproduction steps, Python version, and error traceback |

## Using an Issue Template

1. Navigate to the **Issues** tab of this repository on GitHub.
2. Click **New issue**.
3. Select the relevant template.
4. Fill in all sections before submitting.

## Adding New Templates

To add a feature request or question template, create a new `.md` file in this
directory with the following front matter:

```yaml
---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new algorithm or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---
```
```
